_readme: NFTs shown on the home page, in this order (max 12). Write the title exactly as on the site, or contract:tokenId. Works whose image is still missing are shown last. If fewer than 8 are found, the site adds the newest work of other artists. 'pieceOfTheDay' sets the piece of the day by hand for a date (YYYY-MM-DD → inventory number or exact title); other days are picked automatically.
